The View Configurator allows authorized users to create, manage, and assign multiple screen views based on business needs, while ensuring compliance with the constraints defined by the SLC.
Sales Order List & Creation
This specification covers UI-level enhancements for the Sales Order List screen only. The scope includes:
• Improved filtering and navigation options for easier identification of relevant sales orders.
• Enhanced visibility of key order, delivery, and style-level details directly from the list view.
• Quick-access mechanisms to drill down into delivery and style information without additional navigation.
• A configurable provision to display either:
• The top 50 transactions, or
• Only user-created transactions,
in alignment with the current system functionality.

• Creation, revision, viewing, and reopening of Sales Orders
• Field-level edit permissions (price, quantity, delivery dates, shipment mode, payment terms, etc.)

chunks.text:
• Global Field Visibility Control
• Administrators can configure which fields should be visible, hidden, or optional.
• These rules apply company-wide, ensuring consistent behaviour for all users.
• Global Caption Customization
• SLC includes the ability to change the caption or display name of any field.
• This supports industry-specific terminology or localized naming requirements.
• Uniform UI Structure
• The SLC determines the default layout of the Sales Order screen.
• Controls the sequence of fields, grouping, or panel structure (if applicable).
• Company-Level Enforcement
• Once activated for a company, all users inherit the same base layout.
• Individual users cannot override SLC settings unless permitted via the View Configurator.

chunks.title: Fields Section of OC creation (List Type: Sales Order New)
chunks.heading: Solution › 1. Screen Layout Configurator (SLC) › 1.3 Global Configuration Level › Fields Section of OC creation (List Type: Sales Order New)
chunks.text:
Field Behaviour & Validation Rules
1. Order Season
• The Order Season field will always be auto-populated from the user profile.
• The field will be non-editable during Sales Order Creation.
2. Payment Terms
• The mandatory behaviour of Payment Terms depends on the Order Type:
• If Order Type = Provisional or Projection
→ Payment Terms will be non-mandatory.
• For all other Order Types
→ Payment Terms will be mandatory.
3. Consignee Address
• The mandatory behaviour of Consignee Address depends on the Order Type:
• If Order Type = Provisional or Projection
→ Consignee Address will be non-mandatory.
• For all other Order Types
→ Consignee Address will be mandatory.
4. LC Number
• The LC Number field will be mandatory only when:
Payment Type = LC
• For all other payment types, the field will remain optional.
5. OC Factory
• If Order Type = CM:
• The label “OC Factory” will be renamed to “Supplier”.
• The field will become mandatory.
• For all other Order Types:
• The field will retain the label “OC Factory”.
• The field will remain optional (unless defined otherwise).
6. OC Delivery Date
• OC Delivery Date will always be auto-populated with the Buyer Delivery Date.
• Manual modification of this field will not be allowed unless explicitly permitted by configuration.
7. Bill To
• The Bill To field will be auto-populated from the Buyer Master.

chunks.heading: Solution › 2. View Configurator – User/Department-Level › … › 2.1 Personalized or Department-Specific Views
chunks.text:
In the list type we need two options: -
1. Sales Order New: For the Sales Order Creation Transaction.
2. Sales Order List: For the Sales Order List UI.
Sales Order List: -
Sales Order New: -
• The system shall allow the creation of multiple views for the same Sales Order New & Sales Order List.
• In this we have given a field of buyer which will be mandatory in case of List type -Sales order New only. For the Sales Order List it should be blank.
• Buyer Field: We can select multiple buyer in the list of single view. System should not allow to created multiple view for a single buyer.
• Buyer dropdown should be multi select, System should allow to create the view for multiple buyer.
• The permitted buyer should be come in the dropdown of buyer name.
• In this we have given two toggler options which will work on this sales order list and filter the data on it accordingly.
• Created Order Permission: - It means the system will show the record based on the creation of the logged in user
• Created Order & Buyer wise permission: - It means system will show the record based on the creation of logged in user and also show the permit buyer creation record.
• Default: If we don’t define any config for any user then system will always show as per current working structure of our List UI function.
Note: System should allow to toggle any one of it.

• Individual users

chunks.title: 2.3 Permission-Based Access Control
chunks.heading: Solution › 2. View Configurator – User/Department-Level › … › 2.3 Permission-Based Access Control
chunks.text:
• The system shall provide administrative controls to manage permissions for the View Configurator.
• Administrators can define which users have the ability to:
• Create new views
• Modify existing views
• Assign views based on their user’s group, roles or departments
• Switch between available views
• Users without appropriate permissions will only be able to use assigned views.
• After view permission is granted, the user will be able to see the List Type names based on their assigned permissions.
For example, if a user is granted access to the View Configurator, the system must validate whether the user also has permission for Sales Order Creation and Sales Order List. Based on this permission check, the system will display only those List Type names for which the user has the required access rights, ensuring that users can view details strictly according to their permissions.
Permission should be driven through below given screenshot.
After Click on Divv >> system will open the view permission pop-up where user can set the view permissions accordingly.
Note: - In case of Sales Order Creation: It should be checkbox option for selecting multiple view.
For Sales Order list: It should be radio button, user can permit only one view for a user.

• System detects the Buyer-specific view.
• User has valid permission for PK View.
• Result:
• System displays PK View in Sales Order Creation.

• User Permission: No
• System Action:
• System detects the Buyer-specific view.
• User does not have permission for RK View.
• Result:
• System displays the Default View.

chunks.title: 4.6.3 Delivery Options Fields
chunks.heading: Solution › 4. Sales Order Creation Transaction › 4.6 Delivery and Items Section › 4.6.3 Delivery Options Fields
chunks.text:
OC Factory Column Behaviour for CM Order Type
The OC Factory column requires modification when the Order Type is selected as CM (Cut & Make).
When the Order Type = CM is selected, the system should rename the “OC Factory” field to “Supplier Name.”
The Supplier Name field should be displayed as a dropdown, with values populated from the Supplier Master.
The dropdown list must be filtered based on the selected category, ensuring that only relevant suppliers are available for selection.
GMPO Creation Logic
Based on the selected Supplier Name, the system should automatically create Garment Purchase Orders (GMPOs).
If the sales order contains multiple deliveries, the system should generate separate GMPOs for each delivery.
This means GMPO creation will be delivery-wise, resulting in multiple GMPOs for the same supplier when deliveries differ.
Summary of Expected Behaviour
Order Type = CM → OC Factory renamed to Supplier Name
Supplier selection sourced from Supplier Master
Supplier list filtered by selected category
GMPOs created automatically
GMPOs generated per delivery, not as a single consolidated order

chunks.text:
We need to introduce a new permission named Sales Order, which will include the following options:
• Sales Order – List
• Sales Order – New
In addition, in the last column, a view selection (dropdown/div option) should be provided. This option will open the views created through the View Configurator, allowing the user to select a buyer-wise view.
Note:
• The system should allow the selection of only one view per buyer.
Note: -
In the Sales Order Creation process, no separate view configuration permission is required. The system behaviour will be driven entirely by Buyer-level permissions.
Users will be able to select only those Buyers for which they have been granted access. Once a Buyer is selected, the system will automatically load the corresponding Sales Order Creation view mapped to that Buyer.
For Sales Order list: It should be radio button, user can permit only one view for a user

chunks.title: 5.2 Menu Navigation
chunks.heading: Solution › 5. Menu Permission and UI Navigations › 5.2 Menu Navigation
chunks.text:
We also need to introduce a new submenu under the Sales menu named Sales Order, which will have the following options:
• List:
• This option will open the new Sales Order List user interface.
• New:
• This option will open the New Sales Order creation transaction interface.
In cases where both menu permissions (Old Sales Order and New Sales Order) are assigned to a user, the system behaviour should be as follows:
• The system should always open the New Sales Order List UI and the New Sales Order Creation UI by default.
• Users must create all new sales orders exclusively through the New Sales Order transaction.
However, for sales orders that were originally created using the old transaction (i.e., Purchase Order from Buyer transaction):
• These orders should appear in the New Sales Order List UI.
• When a user attempts to open such an order, it should always open in the Old Sales Order transaction UI.
• If the user performs any revision or amendment on these orders, the system should continue to open them in the Old transaction UI for all subsequent modifications.
Note: If no view is defined in the user permissions, the system should automatically apply the default view for those users.
